idea: Barbell: the two strongest hot numbers plus two of Cold's numbers
why: Cold has won the K4 four times since round 41 and hot policies keep cashing too, so this ticket holds both ends. 50 is the most drawn number over 100 games (37) and 4 is hot on both clocks (34 in 100, 8 in the last 20); they sit in 5 and 6 policies' top 6. 67 and 11 are Cold's #3 and #4 (Agreement already carries Cold's #1 and #2), and 11 is also Overdue's #2, so it's backed from two angles.
